observed_source_gap: Current raw-speech cached() checked cancellation after the selected engine returned and before cache.seal; its finally deleted the completed but unreceipted private chunk. Existing tests cancelled after checkpoint and did not cover this boundary.
repair: Use the same project-locked private ChunkCache and receipt schema. Only after a raw selected-engine synthesize call returns, defer observed cancellation during PCM/hash/quota/copy/receipt acceptance for at most five seconds at existing bounded I/O checks. Restore the exact original callback in finally, then the existing checkpoint acknowledges cancellation before processing/mixing/another synthesis.
integrity: Existing seal verifies PCM header and single-link identity; copied raw PCM must now match its pre-copy SHA256 via existing publish_new expected_sha256. No new cache format or runtime owner.
latency_limit: Cooperative bounded I/O checks permit at most five seconds after first observed cancellation; this does not claim an operating-system timeout for a blocked filesystem flush.
preserved: no new inference or complete-book publication after observed stop
invalid/truncated/aliased output cannot become an accepted chunk
seal errors remain errors even if stop is requested
existing cache quotas, immutable readers, no-clobber publication and cleanup remain
verified accepted speech resumes without resynthesis or byte/mtime changes
test_scope: Three primary boundary variants use actual selected FFmpeg Flite and exact no-resynthesis replay. Three actual-return corruption variants, publication failure, pre-start refusal, a deterministic cooperative deadline and a source-to-copy digest race exercise refusal/cleanup. No real speech quality, SAPI, model, listening or NVDA inference claim.
